test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the option that arranges the given parts in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent passage.**

a) Non-verbal communication is a means

b) This is possible by using visual clues

c) By which you are able to communicate without speaking

d) Such as facial expressions, eye-contact, postures, gestures etc.
solution:
The correct answer is **'**a, c, b, d**'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• From the **given jumbled parts**, we can make out that the sentence is related to non-verbal
